Sweden – Bosnia-Herzegovina at Strawberry Arena on November 14!

The group stage of the Nations League 2026 has been drawn and the Swedish men's national team ended up in an exciting group with Bosnia-Herzegovina, Romania and Poland. The Nations League will be held in double home/away matches in 2026 starting in September and decisive matches in November.

Strawberry Arena is located in Arenastaden in Solna, just north of Stockholm and 10 minutes away from Stockholm City. The easiest way to get to and from the arena is by public transportation, such as commuter trains, light rail, subway, or bus.
Information about whether a cloakroom will be available will be updated on the website and sent out in a welcome email a few days before the event.
It is not permitted to bring umbrellas, bottles, professional cameras, food, or drinks into the arena. No bags larger than 40x40x20 cm are allowed inside. All bags will be checked at the entrance.
Many visitors are expected and as the level of security is high, entry may take time. Please arrive in advance.

At Strawberry Arena, there are plenty of options to satisfy your hunger and quench your thirst at our restaurants, bars, and kiosks. Specific offerings and opening hours will be presented closer to the event.
